info.author: EnigmaWeather Team
info.name: EnigmaWeather
info.shortdescription: Modern weather plugin with Open-Meteo API
info.description:
EnigmaWeather is a modern weather plugin for Enigma2 featuring:
- Real-time weather conditions
- Daily and hourly forecasts
- Open-Meteo API (free, no API key required)
- Satellite image animation
- Location search
- WMO weather codes with day/night icons
- Thread-safe caching (1 hour TTL)
- No additional Python packages required
